job_title: Business Analyst, Travel Research and Analysis
job_description:
Must be located in Ontario, Canada

Description

The Business Analyst, Travel Research & Analysis is responsible for investigating travel booking issues, customer complaints, operational discrepancies, and travel technology platform defects. This role partners closely with the Senior Manager, Travel Research & Analysis to conduct detailed research, perform root cause analysis, identify corrective actions, and support the resolution of customer and operational issues.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and problem-solving skills with extensive travel industry knowledge. They must be able to navigate travel reservation systems, analyze booking data, understand travel agency workflows, and work cross-functionally with Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, and Customer Service teams to improve platform performance and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Research & Investigation

• Investigate complex customer issues, booking discrepancies, ticketing problems, refund requests, and service failures.
• Research travel records, reservation data, transaction history, GDS activity, supplier information, and customer interactions to identify root causes.
• Review system logs, booking workflows, and operational processes to determine where failures occurred.
• Document research findings and provide detailed recommendations for resolution.
• Assist with high-priority customer escalations requiring detailed analysis and investigation.

Defect Analysis & Root Cause Identification

• Analyze reported platform defects and system issues impacting customers or operations.
• Work with Product and Technology teams to reproduce issues and identify root causes.
• Document business requirements and defect details for technical teams.
• Validate that reported fixes fully resolve identified issues.
• Track recurring issues and identify trends requiring broader corrective action.

Travel Operations Support

• Serve as a subject matter expert on travel booking processes across air, hotel, car rental, and ancillary travel products.
• Analyze end-to-end booking workflows to identify process gaps and operational inefficiencies.
• Support investigations involving ticket exchanges, cancellations, refunds, schedule changes, and supplier-related issues.Assist operational teams in researching complex reservation and servicing challenges.

Data Analysis & Reporting

• Analyze booking data, customer complaints, operational metrics, and defect trends.
• Create reports, dashboards, and summaries to support management decision-making.
• Identify recurring customer pain points and recommend improvements.
• Monitor issue resolution effectiveness and customer recovery outcomes.

Business Requirements & Process Improvement

• Translate operational and customer issues into clearly documented business requirements.
• Assist in developing process improvements and operational controls.
• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities for system enhancements and defect fixes.
• Create workflows, process documentation, and knowledge base materials.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with: Product Management, Technology Teams, Customer Service, Supplier Relations, Finance and Reconciliation Teams, Travel Operations
• Participate in defect review meetings and issue resolution discussions.
• Communicate findings and recommendations to business stakeholders.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
• Experience investigating and resolving complex business or customer issues.
• Ability to analyze large data sets and identify patterns and trends.
• Strong organizational and documentation skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Root Cause Analysis

Analyst operates with full technical autonomy over codebases, complex SQL transformations, Python feature engineering, GCP data pipelines, and MLOps back testing suites. Control (Data Layer Ownership) Own the technical design and execution of complex SQL/Python scripts to ingest, transform, and normalize multi-rail transaction data and exogenous feeds. Lead hands-on time-series decomposition, cross-rail migration analytics, correlation mapping, and advanced feature engineering. Develop and code reproducible analytical pipelines that model volume, value, structural shifts, and payment velocity across rails.

Advanced ability to query, transform, normalize, and validate complex multi-rail transaction datasets independently. Solid capability in Python for data preparation, feature engineering, statistical analysis, and reproducible workflow automation. Grounded understanding of time-series concepts, correlation/variable analysis, back-testing, and model validation techniques.

Working familiarity with Google Cloud Platform tools (BigQuery, Cloud Storage) to maintain analytics environments and query large-scale payment data. Familiarity with Vertex AI, model explainability frameworks, or automated deployment tooling.

job_title: Business Analyst, Travel Research and Analysis
job_description:
Must be located in Ontario, Canada

Description

The Business Analyst, Travel Research & Analysis is responsible for investigating travel booking issues, customer complaints, operational discrepancies, and travel technology platform defects. This role partners closely with the Senior Manager, Travel Research & Analysis to conduct detailed research, perform root cause analysis, identify corrective actions, and support the resolution of customer and operational issues.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and problem-solving skills with extensive travel industry knowledge. They must be able to navigate travel reservation systems, analyze booking data, understand travel agency workflows, and work cross-functionally with Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, and Customer Service teams to improve platform performance and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Research & Investigation

• Investigate complex customer issues, booking discrepancies, ticketing problems, refund requests, and service failures.
• Research travel records, reservation data, transaction history, GDS activity, supplier information, and customer interactions to identify root causes.
• Review system logs, booking workflows, and operational processes to determine where failures occurred.
• Document research findings and provide detailed recommendations for resolution.
• Assist with high-priority customer escalations requiring detailed analysis and investigation.

Defect Analysis & Root Cause Identification

• Analyze reported platform defects and system issues impacting customers or operations.
• Work with Product and Technology teams to reproduce issues and identify root causes.
• Document business requirements and defect details for technical teams.
• Validate that reported fixes fully resolve identified issues.
• Track recurring issues and identify trends requiring broader corrective action.

Travel Operations Support

• Serve as a subject matter expert on travel booking processes across air, hotel, car rental, and ancillary travel products.
• Analyze end-to-end booking workflows to identify process gaps and operational inefficiencies.
• Support investigations involving ticket exchanges, cancellations, refunds, schedule changes, and supplier-related issues.Assist operational teams in researching complex reservation and servicing challenges.

Data Analysis & Reporting

• Analyze booking data, customer complaints, operational metrics, and defect trends.
• Create reports, dashboards, and summaries to support management decision-making.
• Identify recurring customer pain points and recommend improvements.
• Monitor issue resolution effectiveness and customer recovery outcomes.

Business Requirements & Process Improvement

• Translate operational and customer issues into clearly documented business requirements.
• Assist in developing process improvements and operational controls.
• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities for system enhancements and defect fixes.
• Create workflows, process documentation, and knowledge base materials.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with: Product Management, Technology Teams, Customer Service, Supplier Relations, Finance and Reconciliation Teams, Travel Operations
• Participate in defect review meetings and issue resolution discussions.
• Communicate findings and recommendations to business stakeholders.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
• Experience investigating and resolving complex business or customer issues.
• Ability to analyze large data sets and identify patterns and trends.
• Strong organizational and documentation skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Root Cause Analysis

job_title: Business Analyst, Travel Research and Analysis
job_description:
Must be located in Ontario, Canada

Description

The Business Analyst, Travel Research & Analysis is responsible for investigating travel booking issues, customer complaints, operational discrepancies, and travel technology platform defects. This role partners closely with the Senior Manager, Travel Research & Analysis to conduct detailed research, perform root cause analysis, identify corrective actions, and support the resolution of customer and operational issues.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and problem-solving skills with extensive travel industry knowledge. They must be able to navigate travel reservation systems, analyze booking data, understand travel agency workflows, and work cross-functionally with Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, and Customer Service teams to improve platform performance and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Research & Investigation

• Investigate complex customer issues, booking discrepancies, ticketing problems, refund requests, and service failures.
• Research travel records, reservation data, transaction history, GDS activity, supplier information, and customer interactions to identify root causes.
• Review system logs, booking workflows, and operational processes to determine where failures occurred.
• Document research findings and provide detailed recommendations for resolution.
• Assist with high-priority customer escalations requiring detailed analysis and investigation.

Defect Analysis & Root Cause Identification

• Analyze reported platform defects and system issues impacting customers or operations.
• Work with Product and Technology teams to reproduce issues and identify root causes.
• Document business requirements and defect details for technical teams.
• Validate that reported fixes fully resolve identified issues.
• Track recurring issues and identify trends requiring broader corrective action.

Travel Operations Support

• Serve as a subject matter expert on travel booking processes across air, hotel, car rental, and ancillary travel products.
• Analyze end-to-end booking workflows to identify process gaps and operational inefficiencies.
• Support investigations involving ticket exchanges, cancellations, refunds, schedule changes, and supplier-related issues.Assist operational teams in researching complex reservation and servicing challenges.

Data Analysis & Reporting

• Analyze booking data, customer complaints, operational metrics, and defect trends.
• Create reports, dashboards, and summaries to support management decision-making.
• Identify recurring customer pain points and recommend improvements.
• Monitor issue resolution effectiveness and customer recovery outcomes.

Business Requirements & Process Improvement

• Translate operational and customer issues into clearly documented business requirements.
• Assist in developing process improvements and operational controls.
• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities for system enhancements and defect fixes.
• Create workflows, process documentation, and knowledge base materials.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with: Product Management, Technology Teams, Customer Service, Supplier Relations, Finance and Reconciliation Teams, Travel Operations
• Participate in defect review meetings and issue resolution discussions.
• Communicate findings and recommendations to business stakeholders.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
• Experience investigating and resolving complex business or customer issues.
• Ability to analyze large data sets and identify patterns and trends.
• Strong organizational and documentation skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Root Cause Analysis

job_title: Business Analyst, Travel Research and Analysis
job_description:
Must be located in Ontario, Canada

Description

The Business Analyst, Travel Research & Analysis is responsible for investigating travel booking issues, customer complaints, operational discrepancies, and travel technology platform defects. This role partners closely with the Senior Manager, Travel Research & Analysis to conduct detailed research, perform root cause analysis, identify corrective actions, and support the resolution of customer and operational issues.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and problem-solving skills with extensive travel industry knowledge. They must be able to navigate travel reservation systems, analyze booking data, understand travel agency workflows, and work cross-functionally with Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, and Customer Service teams to improve platform performance and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Research & Investigation

• Investigate complex customer issues, booking discrepancies, ticketing problems, refund requests, and service failures.
• Research travel records, reservation data, transaction history, GDS activity, supplier information, and customer interactions to identify root causes.
• Review system logs, booking workflows, and operational processes to determine where failures occurred.
• Document research findings and provide detailed recommendations for resolution.
• Assist with high-priority customer escalations requiring detailed analysis and investigation.

Defect Analysis & Root Cause Identification

• Analyze reported platform defects and system issues impacting customers or operations.
• Work with Product and Technology teams to reproduce issues and identify root causes.
• Document business requirements and defect details for technical teams.
• Validate that reported fixes fully resolve identified issues.
• Track recurring issues and identify trends requiring broader corrective action.

Travel Operations Support

• Serve as a subject matter expert on travel booking processes across air, hotel, car rental, and ancillary travel products.
• Analyze end-to-end booking workflows to identify process gaps and operational inefficiencies.
• Support investigations involving ticket exchanges, cancellations, refunds, schedule changes, and supplier-related issues.Assist operational teams in researching complex reservation and servicing challenges.

Data Analysis & Reporting

• Analyze booking data, customer complaints, operational metrics, and defect trends.
• Create reports, dashboards, and summaries to support management decision-making.
• Identify recurring customer pain points and recommend improvements.
• Monitor issue resolution effectiveness and customer recovery outcomes.

Business Requirements & Process Improvement

• Translate operational and customer issues into clearly documented business requirements.
• Assist in developing process improvements and operational controls.
• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities for system enhancements and defect fixes.
• Create workflows, process documentation, and knowledge base materials.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with: Product Management, Technology Teams, Customer Service, Supplier Relations, Finance and Reconciliation Teams, Travel Operations
• Participate in defect review meetings and issue resolution discussions.
• Communicate findings and recommendations to business stakeholders.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
• Experience investigating and resolving complex business or customer issues.
• Ability to analyze large data sets and identify patterns and trends.
• Strong organizational and documentation skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Root Cause Analysis

• Familiarity with: Sabre Red 360, Sabre APIs, NDC content, Airline servicing workflows
• Understanding of travel agency back-office operations including: ARC processing, BSP processing, Ticket reconciliation, Refund management, Debit memos, Credit memos, Quality control procedures

What we are looking for The Senior Analyst: Payments Data Intelligence (PDI) serves as the senior technical lead and quantitative subject matter expert responsible for the hands-on design, execution, and validation of PDI’s analytics engine and predictive modeling workflows. Positioned strategically between analytical support and the PDI Manager, this role owns the technical and statistical integrity of multi-rail payment datasets.

The Senior

Analyst operates with full technical autonomy over codebases, complex SQL transformations, Python feature engineering, GCP data pipelines, and MLOps back testing suites. This role transforms high-level business queries and scenario specifications into production-ready analytical pipelines, automated data quality controls, and validated quantitative outputs. Acting as a genuine analytical thought-partner who understands the statistical significance and underlying data structures behind feature choices, this role ensures data readiness, maintains the analytics environment, validates model inputs, and supports repeatable workflows across multi-rail payment data (Lynx, ACSS, RTR, and other external payment rails).

This individual is a self-directed, highly curious professional capable of bridging technical execution with strategic product goals, working cross-functionally with Data Engineering and Product teams to transform multi-source payment data into trusted, production-ready assets.

Technical Data Ingestion Automated Quality

Control (Data Layer Ownership) Own the technical design and execution of complex SQL/Python scripts to ingest, transform, and normalize multi-rail transaction data and exogenous feeds. Design and maintain automated data validation pipelines, schema enforcement, anomaly flags, and reliability score tagging prior to modeling ingestion. Build and optimize clean, scalable, and documented multi-rail data structures within Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery) to support ongoing cross-rail intelligence.

Data Preparation and Modelling Readiness Assemble and prepare multi-rail payment data (Lynx, ACSS, RTR) and relevant external/exogenous datasets so they are structured for time-series and modelling work. Perform data cleansing, normalization, and reconciliation to ensure model inputs are consistent, accurate, and trustworthy. Build repeatable, automated checks for model input quality, completeness, consistency, and anomaly flags so issues are identified prior to modelling.

Establish clean, well-documented, repeatable workflows for bringing new internal and external data sources into the PDI modelling pipeline.

Data Analytics

Develop an understanding of the payments business to produce business insights, discover patterns and interpret trends stemming from data analysis. Lead hands-on time-series decomposition, cross-rail migration analytics, correlation mapping, and advanced feature engineering. Develop and code reproducible analytical pipelines that model volume, value, structural shifts, and payment velocity across rails.

Prepare datasets and analytical outputs for back-testing, model performance evaluation, and stress/scenario analysis. Code reproducible analytical pipelines that model volume, value, structural shifts, and payment velocity across rails. Produce analytical judgment on data structure and feature choices, providing a critical second set of eyes on the data side of modelling decisions.

Conduct the integration of model outputs (such as explainability/attribution views and pricing-related outputs) into downstream business tools and executive reporting. Develop and maintain clear and concise documentation on process, data sources, and models development Environment and Technical Workflow Manage day-to-day analytics environment configuration (Big Query, Cloud Storage, Vertex AI tooling and related tools), query performance, and computational efficiency escalating complex security or platform work appropriately. Maintain the technical workflow that transitions models into production, including basic automation for repeatable deployment steps.

Ensure and maintain reliable input-quality checks and basic performance monitoring for production models so performance issues are caught early. Facilitate the integration of model outputs (e.g., explainability, attribution, pricing outputs) into downstream business tools. Establish and enforce SQL/Python coding standards, documentation practices, and reproducible analytical workflows.

Author technical data documentation, model validation summaries, and methodology briefs supporting Stage Gate reviews. Cross-Functional Alignment and Stakeholder Delivery Work day-to-day in close partnership with the Lead Data Scientist to prioritize analytical and preparatory work in support of the Product roadmap and PDI strategy. Collaborate cross-functionally with the Data Engineering Team to ensure pipeline compatibility and alignment with platform architecture.

Translate complex technical and statistical findings into plain language for the Director and key product stakeholders.

Technical Skills

Advanced ability to query, transform, normalize, and validate complex multi-rail transaction datasets independently. Solid capability in Python for data preparation, feature engineering, statistical analysis, and reproducible workflow automation. Grounded understanding of time-series concepts, correlation/variable analysis, back-testing, and model validation techniques.

Working familiarity with Google Cloud Platform tools (BigQuery, Cloud Storage) to maintain analytics environments and query large-scale payment data. Familiarity with Vertex AI, model explainability frameworks, or automated deployment tooling.

Professional Competencies

Develop and Mentor others: Supporting others to develop and learn, recognizing their achievements, and building an organizational culture where knowledge and growth are valued and rewarded.

Demonstrate Mature Confidence: Demonstrating confidence and realistic trust in one's own abilities. Understanding and managing their own emotions and drives, and the impact of self on others to minimize counterproductive actions, instill trust and inspire others.

Think Strategically: Seeing and synthesizing different sides of an issue, examining the full range of options and outcomes, and building intellectual frameworks to guide analysis and action.

Make Decisions: Using critical thinking, good business sense and organizational values to make decisions involving varying levels of risk and ambiguity.

Drive Success: Understanding the workings, structure, culture, as well as the distribution of power within and beyond the organization; utilizing this understanding to solve problems and achieve desired outcomes.

Apply Business Acumen: Continually seeking new ways to enhance performance, improve results and/or transform the business and the industry in which it operates. Minimum of five (5) years of experience in data analytics, data science support, or quantitative analysis.

Strong statistical grounding with comfort in time-series concepts, correlation analysis, and feature engineering to act as a thought-partner to data scientists. Solid technical proficiency in Python and SQL for data preparation, transformation, and validation. Working familiarity with cloud analytics environments (BigQuery or equivalent) with explicit enthusiasm to master Google Cloud Platform tools.

Hands-on experience building or supporting data validation, cleansing, normalization, and quality control processes. Ability to translate complex technical work into clear, non-technical briefings for leadership and cross-functional teams. Self-directed mindset with high ownership, strong problem-solving orientation, and comfort navigating ambiguity.

Exposure to Vertex AI or model-deployment tooling, workflow automation tools, model explainability techniques, or prior exposure to payment market infrastructure (Lynx, ACSS, RTR) is considered as an asset. The Business Analyst, Travel Research & Analysis is responsible for investigating travel booking issues, customer complaints, operational discrepancies, and travel technology platform defects. Description

The Business Analyst, Travel Research & Analysis is responsible for investigating travel booking issues, customer complaints, operational discrepancies, and travel technology platform defects. This role partners closely with the Senior Manager, Travel Research & Analysis to conduct detailed research, perform root cause analysis, identify corrective actions, and support the resolution of customer and operational issues.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and problem-solving skills with extensive travel industry knowledge. They must be able to navigate travel reservation systems, analyze booking data, understand travel agency workflows, and work cross-functionally with Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, and Customer Service teams to improve platform performance and customer satisfaction.

Research & Investigation

• Investigate complex customer issues, booking discrepancies, ticketing problems, refund requests, and service failures.
• Research travel records, reservation data, transaction history, GDS activity, supplier information, and customer interactions to identify root causes.
• Review system logs, booking workflows, and operational processes to determine where failures occurred.
• Document research findings and provide detailed recommendations for resolution.
• Assist with high-priority customer escalations requiring detailed analysis and investigation.

• Analyze booking data, customer complaints, operational metrics, and defect trends.
• Create reports, dashboards, and summaries to support management decision-making.
• Identify recurring customer pain points and recommend improvements.
• Monitor issue resolution effectiveness and customer recovery outcomes.

Business Requirements & Process Improvement

• Translate operational and customer issues into clearly documented business requirements.
• Assist in developing process improvements and operational controls.

• Create workflows, process documentation, and knowledge base materials.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Strong organizational and documentation skills.

job_title: Business Analyst, Travel Research and Analysis
job_description:
Must be located in Ontario, Canada

Description

The Business Analyst, Travel Research & Analysis is responsible for investigating travel booking issues, customer complaints, operational discrepancies, and travel technology platform defects. This role partners closely with the Senior Manager, Travel Research & Analysis to conduct detailed research, perform root cause analysis, identify corrective actions, and support the resolution of customer and operational issues.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and problem-solving skills with extensive travel industry knowledge. They must be able to navigate travel reservation systems, analyze booking data, understand travel agency workflows, and work cross-functionally with Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, and Customer Service teams to improve platform performance and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Research & Investigation

• Investigate complex customer issues, booking discrepancies, ticketing problems, refund requests, and service failures.
• Research travel records, reservation data, transaction history, GDS activity, supplier information, and customer interactions to identify root causes.
• Review system logs, booking workflows, and operational processes to determine where failures occurred.
• Document research findings and provide detailed recommendations for resolution.
• Assist with high-priority customer escalations requiring detailed analysis and investigation.

Defect Analysis & Root Cause Identification

• Analyze reported platform defects and system issues impacting customers or operations.
• Work with Product and Technology teams to reproduce issues and identify root causes.
• Document business requirements and defect details for technical teams.
• Validate that reported fixes fully resolve identified issues.
• Track recurring issues and identify trends requiring broader corrective action.

Travel Operations Support

• Serve as a subject matter expert on travel booking processes across air, hotel, car rental, and ancillary travel products.
• Analyze end-to-end booking workflows to identify process gaps and operational inefficiencies.
• Support investigations involving ticket exchanges, cancellations, refunds, schedule changes, and supplier-related issues.Assist operational teams in researching complex reservation and servicing challenges.

Data Analysis & Reporting

• Analyze booking data, customer complaints, operational metrics, and defect trends.
• Create reports, dashboards, and summaries to support management decision-making.
• Identify recurring customer pain points and recommend improvements.
• Monitor issue resolution effectiveness and customer recovery outcomes.

Business Requirements & Process Improvement

• Translate operational and customer issues into clearly documented business requirements.
• Assist in developing process improvements and operational controls.
• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities for system enhancements and defect fixes.
• Create workflows, process documentation, and knowledge base materials.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with: Product Management, Technology Teams, Customer Service, Supplier Relations, Finance and Reconciliation Teams, Travel Operations
• Participate in defect review meetings and issue resolution discussions.
• Communicate findings and recommendations to business stakeholders.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
• Experience investigating and resolving complex business or customer issues.
• Ability to analyze large data sets and identify patterns and trends.
• Strong organizational and documentation skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Root Cause Analysis
• Business Analysis
• Travel Industry Knowledge
• Sabre Expertise
• Data Analysis
• Problem Solving
• Research & Investigation Customer Focus
• Process Improvement
• Documentation
• Critical Thinking
• Stakeholder Management

Work Experience & Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Travel Management, Information Systems, Hospitality, or related field.
• 3-5+ years of experience in travel operations, travel technology, business analysis, or customer issue management.
• Ability to communicate in English (verbally and written) in a polished and professional manner is required.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with Sabre GDS including: Air reservations, Ticketing, Exchanges, REfunds, Queue management, PNR analysis
• Familiarity with: Sabre Red 360, Sabre APIs, NDC content, Airline servicing workflows
• Understanding of travel agency back-office operations including: ARC processing, BSP processing, Ticket reconciliation, Refund management, Debit memos, Credit memos, Quality control procedures
• Experience with online booking tools and travel technology platforms.
• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
• Experience with reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar platforms.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

• Must have a dedicated, quiet, and private workspace free from distractions.
• Ability to sit and remain at a desk for extended periods (up to 8 hours per day) while operating a computer and telephone headset.
• Reliable high-speed uninterrupted internet connection meeting minimum company standards.
• Ability to use hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment.
• Clear, polished and professional verbal & written communication and active listening skills to effectively interact with clients and team members.
• May occasionally require walking, standing, or light lifting (up to 10 pounds) of equipment such as a laptop or office supplies

job_title: Business Analyst, Travel Research and Analysis
job_description:
Must be located in Ontario, Canada

Description

The Business Analyst, Travel Research & Analysis is responsible for investigating travel booking issues, customer complaints, operational discrepancies, and travel technology platform defects. This role partners closely with the Senior Manager, Travel Research & Analysis to conduct detailed research, perform root cause analysis, identify corrective actions, and support the resolution of customer and operational issues.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and problem-solving skills with extensive travel industry knowledge. They must be able to navigate travel reservation systems, analyze booking data, understand travel agency workflows, and work cross-functionally with Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, and Customer Service teams to improve platform performance and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Research & Investigation

• Investigate complex customer issues, booking discrepancies, ticketing problems, refund requests, and service failures.
• Research travel records, reservation data, transaction history, GDS activity, supplier information, and customer interactions to identify root causes.
• Review system logs, booking workflows, and operational processes to determine where failures occurred.
• Document research findings and provide detailed recommendations for resolution.
• Assist with high-priority customer escalations requiring detailed analysis and investigation.

Defect Analysis & Root Cause Identification

• Analyze reported platform defects and system issues impacting customers or operations.
• Work with Product and Technology teams to reproduce issues and identify root causes.
• Document business requirements and defect details for technical teams.
• Validate that reported fixes fully resolve identified issues.
• Track recurring issues and identify trends requiring broader corrective action.

Travel Operations Support

• Serve as a subject matter expert on travel booking processes across air, hotel, car rental, and ancillary travel products.
• Analyze end-to-end booking workflows to identify process gaps and operational inefficiencies.
• Support investigations involving ticket exchanges, cancellations, refunds, schedule changes, and supplier-related issues.Assist operational teams in researching complex reservation and servicing challenges.

Data Analysis & Reporting

• Analyze booking data, customer complaints, operational metrics, and defect trends.
• Create reports, dashboards, and summaries to support management decision-making.
• Identify recurring customer pain points and recommend improvements.
• Monitor issue resolution effectiveness and customer recovery outcomes.

Business Requirements & Process Improvement

• Translate operational and customer issues into clearly documented business requirements.
• Assist in developing process improvements and operational controls.
• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities for system enhancements and defect fixes.
• Create workflows, process documentation, and knowledge base materials.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with: Product Management, Technology Teams, Customer Service, Supplier Relations, Finance and Reconciliation Teams, Travel Operations
• Participate in defect review meetings and issue resolution discussions.
• Communicate findings and recommendations to business stakeholders.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
• Experience investigating and resolving complex business or customer issues.
• Ability to analyze large data sets and identify patterns and trends.
• Strong organizational and documentation skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Root Cause Analysis

• Ability to communicate in English (verbally and written) in a polished and professional manner is required.

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with: Sabre Red 360, Sabre APIs, NDC content, Airline servicing workflows
• Understanding of travel agency back-office operations including: ARC processing, BSP processing, Ticket reconciliation, Refund management, Debit memos, Credit memos, Quality control procedures

job_title: Business Analyst, Travel Research and Analysis
job_description:
Must be located in Ontario, Canada

Description

The Business Analyst, Travel Research & Analysis is responsible for investigating travel booking issues, customer complaints, operational discrepancies, and travel technology platform defects. This role partners closely with the Senior Manager, Travel Research & Analysis to conduct detailed research, perform root cause analysis, identify corrective actions, and support the resolution of customer and operational issues.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and problem-solving skills with extensive travel industry knowledge. They must be able to navigate travel reservation systems, analyze booking data, understand travel agency workflows, and work cross-functionally with Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, and Customer Service teams to improve platform performance and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Research & Investigation

• Investigate complex customer issues, booking discrepancies, ticketing problems, refund requests, and service failures.
• Research travel records, reservation data, transaction history, GDS activity, supplier information, and customer interactions to identify root causes.
• Review system logs, booking workflows, and operational processes to determine where failures occurred.
• Document research findings and provide detailed recommendations for resolution.
• Assist with high-priority customer escalations requiring detailed analysis and investigation.

Defect Analysis & Root Cause Identification

• Analyze reported platform defects and system issues impacting customers or operations.
• Work with Product and Technology teams to reproduce issues and identify root causes.
• Document business requirements and defect details for technical teams.
• Validate that reported fixes fully resolve identified issues.
• Track recurring issues and identify trends requiring broader corrective action.

Travel Operations Support

• Serve as a subject matter expert on travel booking processes across air, hotel, car rental, and ancillary travel products.
• Analyze end-to-end booking workflows to identify process gaps and operational inefficiencies.
• Support investigations involving ticket exchanges, cancellations, refunds, schedule changes, and supplier-related issues.Assist operational teams in researching complex reservation and servicing challenges.

Data Analysis & Reporting

• Analyze booking data, customer complaints, operational metrics, and defect trends.
• Create reports, dashboards, and summaries to support management decision-making.
• Identify recurring customer pain points and recommend improvements.
• Monitor issue resolution effectiveness and customer recovery outcomes.

Business Requirements & Process Improvement

• Translate operational and customer issues into clearly documented business requirements.
• Assist in developing process improvements and operational controls.
• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities for system enhancements and defect fixes.
• Create workflows, process documentation, and knowledge base materials.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with: Product Management, Technology Teams, Customer Service, Supplier Relations, Finance and Reconciliation Teams, Travel Operations
• Participate in defect review meetings and issue resolution discussions.
• Communicate findings and recommendations to business stakeholders.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
• Experience investigating and resolving complex business or customer issues.
• Ability to analyze large data sets and identify patterns and trends.
• Strong organizational and documentation skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Root Cause Analysis

Work Experience & Qualifications

• 3-5+ years of experience in travel operations, travel technology, business analysis, or customer issue management.
• Ability to communicate in English (verbally and written) in a polished and professional manner is required.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with Sabre GDS including: Air reservations, Ticketing, Exchanges, REfunds, Queue management, PNR analysis
• Familiarity with: Sabre Red 360, Sabre APIs, NDC content, Airline servicing workflows
• Understanding of travel agency back-office operations including: ARC processing, BSP processing, Ticket reconciliation, Refund management, Debit memos, Credit memos, Quality control procedures
• Experience with online booking tools and travel technology platforms.

The Business Analyst will participate in the use case discovery sessions, assist the team in a range of strategic planning activities, produce analysis documentation, and create test cases that they will then execute to ensure the quality of all solutions.

Essential Functions, Responsibilities & Duties may include, but are not limited to:
• Elicit and clearly document business and systems requirements.
• Assess business process and system inefficiencies.
• Demonstrated fluency in business processes and process differentiation.
• Ability to analyze and synthesize business requirements, including recognizing patterns and conceptualizing processes.
• Understand and negotiate the needs and expectations of multiple stakeholders.
• Provide and support the implementation of business solutions by building relationships and partnerships with key stakeholders.
• Identify business needs.

• Collaborate closely with developers to implement the requirements.
• Identify all needed test cases for a solution based on an understanding of the business process and solution.
• Create Test Plans and documents
• Test all solutions and work with developers to address any bugs or issues.
• Assist with change requests and business processes.

• Asking questions during discovery sessions that are based on careful logical consideration of the information the clients relay about the business process.

• Continuing to carefully consider any logical inconsistencies or gaps in the team’s knowledge of the business process throughout a use-case, from inception through deployment of the solution.
• Draft test cases for each process and determine all the various routes by which a solution must be tested.

• PowerPoint presentation slide decks, graphs, charts, and visuals for various requirements.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Positive attitude and motivation to deliver the highest quality work.

Job ID: 2026-19913

Career Area: Purchasing

Position Type: Stage

Location: Green Campus, Poissy,

, FR

Date Posted: October 1, 2026

Contexte et environnement de travail Ce poste fera partie de l’organisation Global Purchasing Data & AI, dédiée au développement et au déploiement à grande échelle des capacités d’Intelligence Artificielle au sein des Achats. L’équipe travaille en collaboration avec les experts métier des Achats, les Data Analysts et les Ontology Engineers afin d’identifier les problématiques pour lesquelles l’IA peut améliorer la prise de décision, la productivité, l’automatisation et la performance opérationnelle. L’objectif de ce recrutement est de contribuer au développement, aux tests et à l’intégration de solutions d’intelligence artificielle, en s’appuyant sur les données Achats et sur des technologies d’entreprise telles que Palantir AIP et Microsoft Copilot. Le poste est basé à Poissy, France. Après une période d’intégration sur site, vous pourrez effectuer une partie de vos missions en télétravail. Le temps passé sur site et à distance sera déterminé en fonction des besoins du service et de l’organisation, en accord avec votre responsable. Aucun déplacement n’est prévu dans le cadre de ce poste. Vos missions Au cours de cette expérience, vos principales missions seront les suivantes: Collaborer avec les experts Achats afin d’identifier les problématiques métier et les opportunités pouvant être traitées grâce à l’Intelligence Artificielle, au Machine Learning, à l’IA générative et à l’analytique avancée. Explorer les données Achats, qu’elles soient structurées ou non structurées, afin d’identifier des modèles, des tendances et des opportunités de solutions basées sur l’IA. Participer au développement, aux tests et à l’évaluation de modèles d’IA, de prototypes, d’agents intelligents et d’applications intégrant l’intelligence artificielle. Développer des solutions en Python et mettre en œuvre les technologies IA/Machine Learning adaptées, notamment les fonctionnalités disponibles dans Palantir AIP. Identifier les opportunités d’intégration des capacités d’IA dans les tableaux de bord Palantir existants, les produits de données et les processus métiers des Achats. Collaborer avec les Ontology Engineers afin d’exploiter les objets de l’ontologie Achats et les données connectées comme socle des solutions d’intelligence artificielle. Travailler avec les Data Analysts et les utilisateurs métier afin de garantir que les solutions d’IA répondent à des besoins réels et s’intègrent efficacement dans l’expérience utilisateur. Participer à l’expérimentation de technologies telles que Palantir AIP et Microsoft Copilot, ainsi qu’à l’évaluation de leurs cas d’usage potentiels dans le domaine des Achats. Documenter les méthodologies, les hypothèses, les tests et les résultats, puis présenter les conclusions aussi bien à des publics techniques qu’à des interlocuteurs métiers.

job_description:
Stripe, Inc. is seeking a data science intern in Canada to work on projects across the analytics stack.

You will own problems end to end with mentor support, collaborating with teams to extract insights from complex data and to build metrics, dashboards, and reports that inform business decisions. L’équipe travaille à l’échelle internationale avec les équipes métiers des Achats et les équipes techniques afin de transformer les besoins métier en produits de données intuitifs, tableaux de bord et solutions intégrant l’intelligence artificielle.

Après une période d’intégration sur site, vous pourrez effectuer une partie de vos missions en télétravail.

Le temps de présence sur site et à distance sera déterminé en fonction des besoins du service et de l’organisation, en accord avec votre responsable. Aucun déplacement n’est prévu dans le cadre de ce poste.

Our Data & Analytics organisation builds the products, platforms and intelligence that power marketing, product and commercial decision making across the business.

As we continue investing in first-party data, machine learning and AI, we're looking for an experienced Data Science Manager to help turn these capabilities into scalable products that deliver measurable business value.

Overview

We're looking for a Data Science Manager who can turn commercial problems into scalable Data Science products.

You'll work closely with business and marketing teams to identify high-value opportunities, lead the development of reusable predictive models, and ensure those models become embedded in how the business makes decisions.

This is a player-coach role. You'll lead and develop a growing team of Data Scientists while remaining close enough to the work to shape methodology, review technical outputs and contribute hands-on where needed. Your success won't be measured by how many models the team builds, but by how widely they're used and the commercial impact they create.

The Opportunity

You'll work closely with the Director of Data Science to turn our Data Science strategy into scalable products and measurable business outcomes. You'll manage the day-to-day work of a growing team while partnering directly with stakeholders across the business to understand the decisions they're trying to make and identify where Data Science can materially improve the outcome.

Our Data Science team works at the intersection of customer intelligence, performance marketing and commercial decision making. Initial areas of focus include lifetime value, propensity modelling, customer value, forecasting and marketing optimisation, including how predictive models can improve bidding and acquisition across platforms such as Google and Meta.

This is not a research-focused role. We want someone who enjoys solving difficult modelling problems but is equally interested in what happens afterwards: how a model gets into production, how people use it, what we learn from it and whether it actually improves performance.

What You'll Do

Commercial & Decision Science

• Work with the Director of Data Science and business and marketing teams to identify high-value opportunities for Data Science, translating commercial problems into predictive models and decision-making products. You'll focus on areas including lifetime value, propensity modelling, customer value, forecasting and performance marketing optimisation, with commercial impact at the centre of how work is prioritised.

Scalable Data Science Products

• Guide the development of reusable models and methodologies that can scale across products, verticals and use cases rather than repeatedly solving the same problems. You'll take work from experimentation through adoption, ensuring outputs are measurable, explainable and designed around how they'll ultimately be used.

Production Data Science

• Work closely with Engineering and ML Ops to turn successful modelling work into reliable production products. You'll ensure models have appropriate experimentation, monitoring, retraining and feedback loops, while partnering with technical teams on the infrastructure needed to operate them at scale.

Business Partnership & Insight

• Build trusted relationships across Marketing, Commercial, Analytics, Product and Engineering. You'll translate business needs into Data Science opportunities and complex modelling into clear recommendations, ensuring the team goes beyond producing predictions to explain what they mean, what we can learn from them and what the business should do next.

Team Leadership & Technical Quality

• Lead and develop a growing team of Data Scientists while remaining technically close to the work. You'll coach the global team, review modelling approaches and technical outputs, establish consistent standards and contribute hands-on where it adds value. You'll create an environment where technical rigour, curiosity and commercial thinking reinforce one another.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for someone who combines strong technical Data Science experience with the commercial judgement and communication skills needed to put it into practice.

You'll Likely Bring

• Experience managing and developing Data Scientists while remaining comfortable working at a technical level.
• Strong experience in predictive modelling, machine learning and customer analytics.
• Experience applying Data Science to commercial or performance marketing problems, ideally including LTV, propensity, customer value or acquisition optimisation.
• Strong Python and SQL skills and experience working within modern cloud-based Data Science environments.
• Experience taking models beyond experimentation and working with Engineering or ML Ops teams to deploy and operate them in production.
• Strong understanding of experimentation and model evaluation, with experience in incrementality or causal inference particularly valuable.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical work into clear recommendations for senior business audiences.
• A product mindset, with an interest in building reusable capabilities rather than one-off models.
• Strong commercial judgement and a focus on measuring the real-world impact of Data Science.

Nice to Have

• Experience in any of the following would be valuable, but we don't expect every candidate to bring all of them:
• Performance marketing and optimisation across Google, Meta or other major advertising platforms.
• Value-based bidding or conversion-value optimisation.
• Direct collaboration with advertising platform Data Science or Marketing Science teams.
• Affiliate marketing, lead generation or digital publishing.
• Financial services, insurance, health or other regulated industries.
• Attribution and marketing measurement.
• Forecasting commercial or marketing performance.
• DSP or advertising optimisation algorithms.
• Modern MLOps tooling and platforms such as Vertex AI.
• Applied AI techniques that complement traditional predictive modelling and decision science.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to help build a Data Science capability where models are expected to do something.

You'll work on commercially significant problems with large datasets, direct connections to marketing and customer outcomes, and a clear route from experimentation into production. You'll have the opportunity to shape how those problems are solved, lead a growing team and work alongside experienced leaders across Data Science, Engineering, Analytics, Product and the wider business.

Most importantly, you'll be judged on the decisions your team improves and the value its products create, not simply the sophistication or number of models it builds.

• Work with the Director of Data Science and business and marketing teams to identify high-value opportunities for Data Science, translating commercial problems into predictive models and decision-making products. You'll focus on areas including lifetime value, propensity modelling, customer value, forecasting and performance marketing optimisation, with commercial impact at the centre of how work is prioritised.

Scalable Data Science Products

• Guide the development of reusable models and methodologies that can scale across products, verticals and use cases rather than repeatedly solving the same problems. You'll take work from experimentation through adoption, ensuring outputs are measurable, explainable and designed around how they'll ultimately be used.

Production Data Science

• Work closely with Engineering and ML Ops to turn successful modelling work into reliable production products. You'll ensure models have appropriate experimentation, monitoring, retraining and feedback loops, while partnering with technical teams on the infrastructure needed to operate them at scale.

Business Partnership & Insight

• Build trusted relationships across Marketing, Commercial, Analytics, Product and Engineering. You'll translate business needs into Data Science opportunities and complex modelling into clear recommendations, ensuring the team goes beyond producing predictions to explain what they mean, what we can learn from them and what the business should do next.

Team Leadership & Technical Quality

• Lead and develop a growing team of Data Scientists while remaining technically close to the work. You'll coach the global team, review modelling approaches and technical outputs, establish consistent standards and contribute hands-on where it adds value. You'll create an environment where technical rigour, curiosity and commercial thinking reinforce one another.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for someone who combines strong technical Data Science experience with the commercial judgement and communication skills needed to put it into practice.

• Experience applying Data Science to commercial or performance marketing problems, ideally including LTV, propensity, customer value or acquisition optimisation.

CONTRIBUTING TO THE CMPA
The Student, Data Engineer, AI Readiness will help transform raw, largely unstructured medical-legal records into governed, high-quality data assets that can be used safely and reliably for AI development and evaluation. This is not a one-time data-cleanup role: the student will help establish reusable data foundations that support CMPA’s broader AI roadmap. This placement offers a rare opportunity to see how disciplined data engineering—including data quality, traceability, privacy protection, and documentation—affects the reliability and auditability of AI systems in a regulated, high-stakes environment.
POSITION OVERVIEW
CMPA's AI & Advanced Analytics team builds AI solutions that process sensitive medical-legal content. We are looking for a co-op student to focus on transforming raw medical-legal data into AI-ready datasets: cleaned, standardized, labeled, and governed so they can reliably train, fine-tune, and evaluate AI models. This role works entirely with internally hosted data and infrastructure (on-prem GPU servers) to maintain strict privacy and security for PHI/PII, and supports real production pipelines already in active development.

You will gain hands‑on experience designing data pipelines and quality controls for sensitive, unstructured information; applying privacy and governance principles in practice; and contributing to AI capabilities that are being developed for real organizational use. You will work closely with experienced AI, data, privacy, and domain professionals.

POSITION ACTIVITIES
• Clean, normalize, and structure raw text from call transcripts, internal documents, and case files into standardized, machine-consumable formats.
• Help define and apply AI-readiness criteria for medical-legal datasets — completeness, consistency, labeling accuracy, lineage, and auditability — so data quality becomes measurable rather than assumed.
• Develop Python scripts and lightweight data pipelines for ingesting, de‑identifying, chunking, formatting, and validating documents at scale, with traceability suitable for audit review.
• Create and maintain evaluation/test sets (e.g., scripted advisor-member conversation samples) to benchmark transcription, summarization, and classification performance.
• Document data preparation standards, labeling guidelines, and known data quality issues so the process is repeatable, governed, and auditable across teams.
• Work closely with the AI program lead to align data preparation work with governance, privacy, and security requirements for regulated healthcare data.
• Support document classification and medical‑legal coding workflows by preparing labeled datasets and validating tagging accuracy against existing coding schemes.
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
• Currently enrolled in a co‑op program in Computer Science, Data Science, Health Informatics, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• Foundational Python programming skills, including experience working with structured or unstructured data. Experience with libraries such as pandas, regular expressions, spaCy, or similar is an asset.
• Familiarity with core NLP or document‑processing concepts—such as text normalization, tokenization, named‑entity recognition, classification, or information extraction—through coursework, personal projects, research, or prior work.
• Ability to work methodically with ambiguous, incomplete, and messy real‑world data.
SKILLS AND ABILITIES
• Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and comfort handling sensitive or high‑stakes information in accordance with established procedures.
• Ability to document data transformations, assumptions, validation steps, and known limitations clearly and consistently.
• Strong written communication and an ability to collaborate remotely with technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
• Exposure to healthcare, legal, insurance, public‑sector, or other regulated‑domain data is an asset.
• Familiarity with privacy‑preserving data practices, including de‑identification or anonymization of PHI/PII is an asset.
• Exposure to data quality, data lineage, metadata, data governance, audit, privacy, security, or compliance concepts is an asset.
• Experience with data annotation, labeling tools, building labeling workflows, or evaluating label quality is an asset.
• Exposure to speech‑to‑text, document OCR, document parsing, or text‑extraction pipelines is an asset.
• Experience working in a Linux, Git, Jupyter, SQL, or API‑based development environment is an asset.

job_description:
CO-OP STUDENT — DATA ENGINEER, AI READINESS (MEDICAL-LEGAL DATA)Fully Remote (Ontario or Quebec)
CONTRIBUTING TO THE CMPA
The Student, Data Engineer, AI Readiness will help transform raw, largely unstructured medical-legal records into governed, high-quality data assets that can be used safely and reliably for AI development and evaluation. This is not a one-time data-cleanup role: the student will help establish reusable data foundations that support CMPA’s broader AI roadmap. This placement offers a rare opportunity to see how disciplined data engineering—including data quality, traceability, privacy protection, and documentation—affects the reliability and auditability of AI systems in a regulated, high-stakes environment.
POSITION OVERVIEW
CMPA's AI & Advanced Analytics team builds AI solutions that process sensitive medical-legal content. We are looking for a co-op student to focus on transforming raw medical-legal data into AI-ready datasets: cleaned, standardized, labeled, and governed so they can reliably train, fine-tune, and evaluate AI models. This role works entirely with internally hosted data and infrastructure (on-prem GPU servers) to maintain strict privacy and security for PHI/PII, and supports real production pipelines already in active development.

You will gain hands‑on experience designing data pipelines and quality controls for sensitive, unstructured information; applying privacy and governance principles in practice; and contributing to AI capabilities that are being developed for real organizational use. You will work closely with experienced AI, data, privacy, and domain professionals.

POSITION ACTIVITIES
• Clean, normalize, and structure raw text from call transcripts, internal documents, and case files into standardized, machine-consumable formats.
• Help define and apply AI-readiness criteria for medical-legal datasets — completeness, consistency, labeling accuracy, lineage, and auditability — so data quality becomes measurable rather than assumed.
• Develop Python scripts and lightweight data pipelines for ingesting, de‑identifying, chunking, formatting, and validating documents at scale, with traceability suitable for audit review.
• Create and maintain evaluation/test sets (e.g., scripted advisor-member conversation samples) to benchmark transcription, summarization, and classification performance.
• Document data preparation standards, labeling guidelines, and known data quality issues so the process is repeatable, governed, and auditable across teams.
• Work closely with the AI program lead to align data preparation work with governance, privacy, and security requirements for regulated healthcare data.
• Support document classification and medical‑legal coding workflows by preparing labeled datasets and validating tagging accuracy against existing coding schemes.
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
• Currently enrolled in a co‑op program in Computer Science, Data Science, Health Informatics, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• Foundational Python programming skills, including experience working with structured or unstructured data. Experience with libraries such as pandas, regular expressions, spaCy, or similar is an asset.
• Familiarity with core NLP or document‑processing concepts—such as text normalization, tokenization, named‑entity recognition, classification, or information extraction—through coursework, personal projects, research, or prior work.
• Ability to work methodically with ambiguous, incomplete, and messy real‑world data.
SKILLS AND ABILITIES
• Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and comfort handling sensitive or high‑stakes information in accordance with established procedures.
• Ability to document data transformations, assumptions, validation steps, and known limitations clearly and consistently.
• Strong written communication and an ability to collaborate remotely with technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
• Exposure to healthcare, legal, insurance, public‑sector, or other regulated‑domain data is an asset.
• Familiarity with privacy‑preserving data practices, including de‑identification or anonymization of PHI/PII is an asset.
• Exposure to data quality, data lineage, metadata, data governance, audit, privacy, security, or compliance concepts is an asset.
• Experience with data annotation, labeling tools, building labeling workflows, or evaluating label quality is an asset.
• Exposure to speech‑to‑text, document OCR, document parsing, or text‑extraction pipelines is an asset.
• Experience working in a Linux, Git, Jupyter, SQL, or API‑based development environment is an asset.

job_description:
CO-OP STUDENT — DATA ENGINEER, AI READINESS (MEDICAL-LEGAL DATA)Fully Remote (Ontario or Quebec)
CONTRIBUTING TO THE CMPA
The Student, Data Engineer, AI Readiness will help transform raw, largely unstructured medical-legal records into governed, high-quality data assets that can be used safely and reliably for AI development and evaluation. This is not a one-time data-cleanup role: the student will help establish reusable data foundations that support CMPA’s broader AI roadmap. This placement offers a rare opportunity to see how disciplined data engineering—including data quality, traceability, privacy protection, and documentation—affects the reliability and auditability of AI systems in a regulated, high-stakes environment.
POSITION OVERVIEW
CMPA's AI & Advanced Analytics team builds AI solutions that process sensitive medical-legal content. We are looking for a co-op student to focus on transforming raw medical-legal data into AI-ready datasets: cleaned, standardized, labeled, and governed so they can reliably train, fine-tune, and evaluate AI models. This role works entirely with internally hosted data and infrastructure (on-prem GPU servers) to maintain strict privacy and security for PHI/PII, and supports real production pipelines already in active development.

You will gain hands‑on experience designing data pipelines and quality controls for sensitive, unstructured information; applying privacy and governance principles in practice; and contributing to AI capabilities that are being developed for real organizational use. You will work closely with experienced AI, data, privacy, and domain professionals.

POSITION ACTIVITIES
• Clean, normalize, and structure raw text from call transcripts, internal documents, and case files into standardized, machine-consumable formats.
• Help define and apply AI-readiness criteria for medical-legal datasets — completeness, consistency, labeling accuracy, lineage, and auditability — so data quality becomes measurable rather than assumed.
• Develop Python scripts and lightweight data pipelines for ingesting, de‑identifying, chunking, formatting, and validating documents at scale, with traceability suitable for audit review.
• Create and maintain evaluation/test sets (e.g., scripted advisor-member conversation samples) to benchmark transcription, summarization, and classification performance.
• Document data preparation standards, labeling guidelines, and known data quality issues so the process is repeatable, governed, and auditable across teams.
• Work closely with the AI program lead to align data preparation work with governance, privacy, and security requirements for regulated healthcare data.
• Support document classification and medical‑legal coding workflows by preparing labeled datasets and validating tagging accuracy against existing coding schemes.
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
• Currently enrolled in a co‑op program in Computer Science, Data Science, Health Informatics, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• Foundational Python programming skills, including experience working with structured or unstructured data. Experience with libraries such as pandas, regular expressions, spaCy, or similar is an asset.
• Familiarity with core NLP or document‑processing concepts—such as text normalization, tokenization, named‑entity recognition, classification, or information extraction—through coursework, personal projects, research, or prior work.
• Ability to work methodically with ambiguous, incomplete, and messy real‑world data.
SKILLS AND ABILITIES
• Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and comfort handling sensitive or high‑stakes information in accordance with established procedures.
• Ability to document data transformations, assumptions, validation steps, and known limitations clearly and consistently.
• Strong written communication and an ability to collaborate remotely with technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
• Exposure to healthcare, legal, insurance, public‑sector, or other regulated‑domain data is an asset.
• Familiarity with privacy‑preserving data practices, including de‑identification or anonymization of PHI/PII is an asset.
• Exposure to data quality, data lineage, metadata, data governance, audit, privacy, security, or compliance concepts is an asset.
• Experience with data annotation, labeling tools, building labeling workflows, or evaluating label quality is an asset.
• Exposure to speech‑to‑text, document OCR, document parsing, or text‑extraction pipelines is an asset.
• Experience working in a Linux, Git, Jupyter, SQL, or API‑based development environment is an asset.

job_description:
CO-OP STUDENT — DATA ENGINEER, AI READINESS (MEDICAL-LEGAL DATA)Fully Remote (Ontario or Quebec)
CONTRIBUTING TO THE CMPA
The Student, Data Engineer, AI Readiness will help transform raw, largely unstructured medical-legal records into governed, high-quality data assets that can be used safely and reliably for AI development and evaluation. This is not a one-time data-cleanup role: the student will help establish reusable data foundations that support CMPA’s broader AI roadmap. This placement offers a rare opportunity to see how disciplined data engineering—including data quality, traceability, privacy protection, and documentation—affects the reliability and auditability of AI systems in a regulated, high-stakes environment.
POSITION OVERVIEW
CMPA's AI & Advanced Analytics team builds AI solutions that process sensitive medical-legal content. We are looking for a co-op student to focus on transforming raw medical-legal data into AI-ready datasets: cleaned, standardized, labeled, and governed so they can reliably train, fine-tune, and evaluate AI models. This role works entirely with internally hosted data and infrastructure (on-prem GPU servers) to maintain strict privacy and security for PHI/PII, and supports real production pipelines already in active development.

You will gain hands‑on experience designing data pipelines and quality controls for sensitive, unstructured information; applying privacy and governance principles in practice; and contributing to AI capabilities that are being developed for real organizational use. You will work closely with experienced AI, data, privacy, and domain professionals.

POSITION ACTIVITIES
• Clean, normalize, and structure raw text from call transcripts, internal documents, and case files into standardized, machine-consumable formats.
• Help define and apply AI-readiness criteria for medical-legal datasets — completeness, consistency, labeling accuracy, lineage, and auditability — so data quality becomes measurable rather than assumed.
• Develop Python scripts and lightweight data pipelines for ingesting, de‑identifying, chunking, formatting, and validating documents at scale, with traceability suitable for audit review.
• Create and maintain evaluation/test sets (e.g., scripted advisor-member conversation samples) to benchmark transcription, summarization, and classification performance.
• Document data preparation standards, labeling guidelines, and known data quality issues so the process is repeatable, governed, and auditable across teams.
• Work closely with the AI program lead to align data preparation work with governance, privacy, and security requirements for regulated healthcare data.
• Support document classification and medical‑legal coding workflows by preparing labeled datasets and validating tagging accuracy against existing coding schemes.
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
• Currently enrolled in a co‑op program in Computer Science, Data Science, Health Informatics, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• Foundational Python programming skills, including experience working with structured or unstructured data. Experience with libraries such as pandas, regular expressions, spaCy, or similar is an asset.
• Familiarity with core NLP or document‑processing concepts—such as text normalization, tokenization, named‑entity recognition, classification, or information extraction—through coursework, personal projects, research, or prior work.
• Ability to work methodically with ambiguous, incomplete, and messy real‑world data.
SKILLS AND ABILITIES
• Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and comfort handling sensitive or high‑stakes information in accordance with established procedures.
• Ability to document data transformations, assumptions, validation steps, and known limitations clearly and consistently.
• Strong written communication and an ability to collaborate remotely with technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
• Exposure to healthcare, legal, insurance, public‑sector, or other regulated‑domain data is an asset.
• Familiarity with privacy‑preserving data practices, including de‑identification or anonymization of PHI/PII is an asset.
• Exposure to data quality, data lineage, metadata, data governance, audit, privacy, security, or compliance concepts is an asset.
• Experience with data annotation, labeling tools, building labeling workflows, or evaluating label quality is an asset.
• Exposure to speech‑to‑text, document OCR, document parsing, or text‑extraction pipelines is an asset.
• Experience working in a Linux, Git, Jupyter, SQL, or API‑based development environment is an asset.

Strong programming skills in languages such as Java or Scala, and Python.

Hands-on experience in Github & Nexus management and its use cases.

Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software development principles.

•

Experience with distributed computing, big data technologies, and cloud platforms is a plus.

Strong understanding and hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including deploying, managing, and scaling applications.

Familiarity with Kubernetes concepts such as Pods, Services, Deployments, StatefulSets, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.

Knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and software development principles.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.

Understanding of the big data ecosystem, including data ingestion, processing, and storage technologies.

Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.

Proven ability to work well in a team environment, contributing to a collaborative culture.

Enthusiasm to learn and adapt to new technologies.

Hiring Brand Description

Parkland is a leading international fuel supplier, convenience store operator, and community enabler, serving diverse customers across 26 countries.
Brief Description

The Technical Services Intern will support safe, reliable, and profitable refinery operations by assisting with troubleshooting, turnaround activities, and improvement projects. This role provides hands-on experience supporting processing units and exposure to refinery processes, including crude distillation, catalytic cracking, hydrotreating, sulfur recovery, utilities, wastewater treatment, and blending.

As of November 1, 2025, Sunoco LP has successfully completed its acquisition of Parkland Corporation. For more information, please visit .

Sunoco LP is a leading energy infrastructure and fuel distribution master limited partnership operating across 32 countries and territories in North America, the Greater Caribbean, and Europe. The Partnership’s midstream operations include an extensive network of approximately 14,000 miles of pipeline and over 160 terminals. This critical infrastructure complements the Partnership’s fuel distribution operations, which distribute over 15 billion gallons annually to approximately 11,000 Sunoco and partner-branded retail locations, as well as independent dealers and commercial customers.

At Sunoco, we take great pride in what we do and wholeheartedly believe our employees drive success for our company and our customers. We are always looking for the best and brightest talent and are committed to making your job a challenging and rewarding experience.

Starting Salary: $27.00-$35.00/hour

The Opportunity

As a member of the Technical Services team supporting the Refinery, you will work to maintain safe, reliable, and profitable operation of the refinery by overseeing operation of assigned units, troubleshoot issues, support turnarounds and improvement projects.

Processes at the Burnaby refinery include crude distillation, fluid catalytic cracking, hydrotreating, isomerization, catalytic reforming, alkylation, sulfur recovery, energy and utilities, wastewater treatment, and blending and shipping.

Responsibilities
• Ensure technical support needs are met for Operations, HSE, Maintenance, Facilities Planning and Supply functions.
• Support planned turnarounds and associated turnaround improvements.
• Supporting process hazard analyses, management of change, and investigations processes.
• Developing business cases and facilitating process and project improvements projects.

Education
• Currently enrolled in a Canadian post-secondary institution and pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering.
• Preference will be given to students in their 3rd, 4th, or 5th year of study with one academic term remaining following the completion of the work term.

Requirements
• Available for a 12-month term beginning in January 2027.
• Strong interpersonal skills and demonstrated leadership through academic and/or extracurricular activities.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to thrive in a highly dynamic work environment.
• Creative and analytical thinker with strong time management skills; self-driven and capable of working in a fast-paced environment.
• Ability to work effectively with a high degree of collaboration and communication through in-person meetings and video conferences.
