job_description:
About Hivery

HIVERY, officially formed in 2015, began with an advanced AI system built with bleeding edge technologies from machine learning, operations research, and design discipline. This system remains at the core of HIVERY to this day, and is continuously improved by an ever-expanding team of scientists, engineers, and designers as we pursue and develop our ultimate vision: The Retail Genome®.

We are a venture backed startup and closed series B funding in July 2022. HIVERY Curate, our flagship product, is the world’s only store-level assortment and space strategy simulation and optimization solution. HIVERY Curate enables a retailer or category manager to run assortment and category simulations and understand the financial impact of any assortment and space decision. Originally located in Sydney, Australia HIVERY is now a globally distributed organization hiring for remote roles in engineering.

We are seeking a new or recent graduate to join us as a Data Engineer in our Curate engineering team. In this role you will:

• Develop features and improvements to the HIVERY Curate product in a secure, well-tested, and performant way.

• Collaborate with Product and other stakeholders within Engineering to maintain a high bar for quality in a fast-paced, iterative environment.

• Solve technical problems of low to moderate scope and complexity.

• Write code that meets our internal standards for style, maintainability, and best practices for data engineering in a high scale environment. Maintain and advocate for these standards through code review

• Collaborate to identify impediments to our efficiency as a team ("technical debt"), propose and implement solutions.

• Represent HIVERY and its values in public communication around specific projects and community contributions.

• Ship small features and improvements with guidance and support from senior team members.

• Participate on-call rotations

To be successful in this role you will need to have:

• Familiarity with object-oriented design patterns, data structures, and algorithms

• Professional or academic experience with Python or Go.

• Professional or academic experience with one or more cloud providers (Azure, AWS, GCP) and infrastructure as code.

• Professional or academic experience with data warehousing, ELT, or ELT

• Professional or academic experience with big data technologies such as Apache Hadoop, Spark, Iceberg

• Proficiency in the English language, both written and verbal, sufficient for success in a remote and asynchronous work environment.

• Excellent communication skills and a capability to communicate with both technical and nontechnical audiences.

• Experience with performance and optimization problems and a demonstrated ability to both diagnose and prevent these problems.

• Comfort working in a highly agile, intensely iterative software development process.

• Positive and solution-oriented mindset.

• Effective communication skills: Tactfully achieve consensus with peers, and clear status updates.

• An inclination towards communication, inclusion, and visibility.

• Self-motivated and self-managing, with excellent organizational skills.

• Share our values, and work in accordance with those values.

• Ability to thrive in a fully remote organization.

The pay range for this role is:

70,000 - 80,000 CAD per year(Remote - Canada)

Agency

Omd

Job Function

Consulting

Job Subfunction

Technology Consulting

Job Description

About the role

The Data Engineering team is responsible for building and maintaining robust data infrastructure and dashboarding solutions for OMD's highest profile clients. We work closely with analytics and strategy teams to ensure clean, reliable, useable data flows and compelling visualizations that drive business insights.

What Will You Do

As a Junior Data Engineer, you will support the execution of our dashboarding roadmap and contribute to ongoing data operations. With guidance from Data Engineering senior stakeholders and MarSci teams, you will be responsible for:

Marketing Data Engineering & Pipeline Development

• Build, maintain, and optimize ETL/ELT workflows supporting marketing analytics and reporting.
• Develop production-ready SQL transformations to clean, structure, and prepare marketing datasets.
• Create reusable datasets and data models that support dashboards, reporting, experimentation, and advanced analytics.
• Collaborate with analytics and marketing science teams to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.

Marketing Cloud Intelligence (Datorama) Dashboard & Data Model Rebuild

• Redesign and optimize the underlying data model within Marketing Cloud Intelligence (Datorama).
• Rebuild data views, datasets, and reporting structures to improve usability and scalability.
• Improve dashboard performance, data refresh processes, and reporting efficiency.
• Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting processes.
• Support evaluation and potential migration of dashboards from Marketing Cloud Intelligence (Datorama) to Tableau.

Data Integration & Data Preparation

• Extract and integrate marketing data from multiple sources, including:
• Marketing Cloud Intelligence (Datorama)
• Google BigQuery
• Vendor-provided CSV/Excel files
• Third-party marketing platforms through APIs
• Build and maintain data ingestion processes to ensure timely and accurate data availability.
• Clean, transform, and standardize data from multiple sources for analysis.

Data Quality & Documentation

• Implement data validation checks to identify data quality issues and inconsistencies.
• Monitor data accuracy and troubleshoot issues affecting reporting and analytics.
• Maintain data dictionaries, metric definitions, and documentation of data processes.
• Ensure consistency in business logic across reporting and analytical datasets.

Marketing Analytics Enablement

• Understand the data requirements behind marketing measurement approaches, including:
• Attribution & Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA)
• Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)
• Incrementality testing & Experimentation
• Forecasting
• Partner with Marketing Science analysts and data scientists to support measurement, modeling, and optimization efforts.

Technical Skills & Experience

• Strong SQL skills and ability to write production-quality queries.
• Experience with data transformation and modeling.
• Experience working with cloud data warehouses (Google BigQuery preferred).
• Familiarity with APIs and data integrations.
• Experience working with marketing analytics data sources is preferred.
• Experience with visualization platforms such as Tableau is an asset.
• Understanding of marketing measurement concepts and analytical methodologies.
• Familiarity with Airflow

What We Are Looking For

Experience & Background: You have 2+ years of experience in data engineering or related technical roles. You have a strong foundation in data fundamentals and are eager to grow your skills. You are comfortable working in technical environments and have a track record of learning new tools quickly.

Technical Skills: You have hands-on experience with the skills outlined above. Proficiency in Excel is expected. You have familiarity with SQL, and basic understanding of data modelling concepts is a plus. You are comfortable working with APIs and databases.

Communication & Problem-Solving: You are a clear communicator, both written and verbal. While technical, you can also explain data concepts to non-technical colleagues. You are a detail-oriented problem solver who approaches challenges methodically, but also creatively if the opportunity arises. You take pride in the quality and accuracy of your work.

Mindset: You are curious and passionate about learning. You work collaboratively with others and are eager to contribute to team success. You are proactive, reliable, and committed to continuous improvement. You understand the importance of data integrity and best practices.

This is an active vacancy. We are currently hiring for this role and reviewing applications on an ongoing basis.

Expected Salary: $55,000 - $65,000

Omnicom Media is providing the compensation range that the company is willing to pay for this position based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities.

In Addition, Omnicom Media Provides Rewarding Offerings Such As

• Generous paid time off with a minimum of 37 paid days off including vacation and monthly wellness days. We also have four-day long weekends, half-day summer Fridays, and meeting-free Friday afternoons year-round.
• A flexible hybrid work model that works for you.
• A focus on personal development with formal training opportunities, including mental health training and inclusion education for everyone.
• A chance to be part of and grow within a global network of agencies.
• The opportunity to contribute to our company culture by joining one of our many community-based employee groups, such as Black Employee Network, Girls on Fire, Hispanic or Latinx Alliance, Neuro Network, Pan-Asian Network, and Rainbow Lounge.

Omnicom is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, creed, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship, genetic information, disability, or any other basis prohibited by applicable federal, provincial, or municipal law. If you require an accommodation in any aspect of the selection process, please reach out to canadatalent@mbww.com

Salary range: $55,000 - $65,000

Omnicom’s policy requires employees to work in the office for a minimum of three days a week, unless additional in-office days are directed by their agency or manager. Our objective is to increase this requirement over time, and many of our agencies as well as Omnicom’s corporate group already require five days of in-office attendance.

Omnicom is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. About the role

The Data Engineering team is responsible for building and maintaining robust data infrastructure and dashboarding solutions for OMD's highest profile clients. We work closely with analytics and strategy teams to ensure clean, reliable, useable data flows and compelling visualizations that drive business insights.

What Will You Do

As a Junior Data Engineer, you will support the execution of our dashboarding roadmap and contribute to ongoing data operations. With guidance from Data Engineering senior stakeholders and MarSci teams, you will be responsible for:

Marketing Data Engineering & Pipeline Development

• Build, maintain, and optimize ETL/ELT workflows supporting marketing analytics and reporting.
• Develop production-ready SQL transformations to clean, structure, and prepare marketing datasets.
• Create reusable datasets and data models that support dashboards, reporting, experimentation, and advanced analytics.
• Collaborate with analytics and marketing science teams to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.

Marketing Cloud Intelligence (Datorama) Dashboard & Data Model Rebuild

• Redesign and optimize the underlying data model within Marketing Cloud Intelligence (Datorama).
• Rebuild data views, datasets, and reporting structures to improve usability and scalability.
• Improve dashboard performance, data refresh processes, and reporting efficiency.
• Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting processes.
• Support evaluation and potential migration of dashboards from Marketing Cloud Intelligence (Datorama) to Tableau.

Data Integration & Data Preparation

• Extract and integrate marketing data from multiple sources, including:
• Marketing Cloud Intelligence (Datorama)
• Google BigQuery
• Vendor-provided CSV/Excel files
• Third-party marketing platforms through APIs
• Build and maintain data ingestion processes to ensure timely and accurate data availability.
• Clean, transform, and standardize data from multiple sources for analysis.

Data Quality & Documentation

• Implement data validation checks to identify data quality issues and inconsistencies.
• Monitor data accuracy and troubleshoot issues affecting reporting and analytics.
• Maintain data dictionaries, metric definitions, and documentation of data processes.
• Ensure consistency in business logic across reporting and analytical datasets.

Marketing Analytics Enablement

• Understand the data requirements behind marketing measurement approaches, including:
• Attribution & Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA)
• Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)
• Incrementality testing & Experimentation
• Forecasting
• Partner with Marketing Science analysts and data scientists to support measurement, modeling, and optimization efforts.

Technical Skills & Experience

• Strong SQL skills and ability to write production-quality queries.
• Experience with data transformation and modeling.
• Experience working with cloud data warehouses (Google BigQuery preferred).
• Familiarity with APIs and data integrations.
• Experience working with marketing analytics data sources is preferred.
• Experience with visualization platforms such as Tableau is an asset.
• Understanding of marketing measurement concepts and analytical methodologies.
• Familiarity with Airflow

Experience & Background: You have 2+ years of experience in data engineering or related technical roles. You have a strong foundation in data fundamentals and are eager to grow your skills. You are comfortable working in technical environments and have a track record of learning new tools quickly.

Technical Skills: You have hands-on experience with the skills outlined above. Proficiency in Excel is expected. You have familiarity with SQL, and basic understanding of data modelling concepts is a plus. You are comfortable working with APIs and databases.

Communication & Problem-Solving: You are a clear communicator, both written and verbal. While technical, you can also explain data concepts to non-technical colleagues. You are a detail-oriented problem solver who approaches challenges methodically, but also creatively if the opportunity arises. You take pride in the quality and accuracy of your work.

Mindset: You are curious and passionate about learning. You work collaboratively with others and are eager to contribute to team success. You are proactive, reliable, and committed to continuous improvement. You understand the importance of data integrity and best practices.
